spans.s:
मौद मौद, आस्, m. pl. (probably fr. मोद),
N. of a school; (अस्), m. a pupil of this school.
मौदहायन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a family.

मौदक मौदक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मोदक),
relating to sweetmeats; dealing or trading in sweet-
meats; (अम्), n. a particular version of a sacred text
by Mauda, (in this sense connected with मौद
above.)

मौदकिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मोदक), consisting
or composed of sweetmeats; (अस्), m. a seller of
sweetmeats, confectioner.

मौदनिक (fr. मोदन), see Gaṇa Kāśyādi to
Pāṇ.
मौदनेयक, see Gaṇa Kattryādi to Pāṇ.

मौदमानिक (fr. मोदमान), see Gaṇa Kāś-
yādi to Pāṇ.
मौदाकिन्, a various reading for मोदाकिन्.

मौद्ग मौद्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मुद्ग), relating
to a bean; (अस्), m., N. of a preceptor.
मौद्गिक, अस्, ई, अम्, purchased with beans.
मौद्गिक मौद्गिक, मौद्गीन. See above.

मौद्गीन, अस्, ई, अम्, sown with beans, fit for
being sown with kidney-beans, bearing beans (said
of a field).

मौद्गलि मौद्गलि, इस्, m. (fr. मुद्गल), a
crow [cf. मौकलि].

मौद्गल्य, descended or sprung from Mudgala;
(अस्), m. a proper N.; patronymic of Nāka; of
Śata-balākṣa; of Lāṅgalāyana; a particular mixed
caste; मौद्गलास्, m. pl., see Gaṇa Kaṇvādi to Pāṇ.

मौद्गल्यायन, अस्, m. (patronymic fr. मौद्-
गल्य), N. of a pupil of Śākya-muni.

मौद्गल्यीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or coming
from Maudgalya.
